fixed: A figure line that states an amount the app cannot read, such as "Circle Left 3/4, make short waves", now stays as your text instead of becoming a figure with a different amount (it used to save circle left 4 places).
"Larks allemande Left 1.5 (face P)" and similar lines with words after the amount now keep the amount you wrote instead of "once".
"Neighbor 2 Do-si-do" now reads as a do-si-do with your next neighbor, not a do-si-do twice, and "Neighbor 1 allemande Left 3/4" turns ¾, not 1¾.
"Pass through along (NR) (optional)" keeps the right shoulder alongside the note "optional".
added: Amounts written as decimals or hyphenated numbers are now read: "1.0", "0.5", "1-1/2", and "Circle Left 5/4" as five places.
"Square through 3 without hands (NR, PL, NR)" in a Caller's Companion library now imports as a circular hey. Without the pass list it imports as a square through noting "without hands".
changed: "Single file promenade clockwise" (or counterclockwise) is now read as a single-file circle left (or right), with any amount as places.
A dancer tag in brackets, such as "(N2)" in "(N2) Right-hand star 1.0", is now kept as the figure's note instead of being dropped.

The free-text fan-out ranks note-bearing readings by the letters and digits left in their notes, with front-end precedence breaking a tie, and rejects a reading whose note opens with an amount it did not take.
